subject: Invoice sender and portal opt-in for Cloudcap
messages:
From: Ava Peterson <ava.peterson@cloudcap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloudcap Finance <billing@cloudcap.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question: who will send the invoice (email vs portal)?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Cloudcap is excited to move forward. A quick operational question from our AP team: for the first set of invoices, do you expect Redwood or Cloudcap to be the publisher of record?

Specifically:
- Can Redwood push invoices to our supplier portal (we have an API integration) or will you email signed PDFs to billing@cloudcap.com?
- We also need VAT evidence attached for EU entities — what format do you provide by default?

We have a PO (PO-7732) and prefer portal delivery long-term, but we need a short path to accept first invoices while portal onboarding finishes.

Appreciate a quick runbook or options.

Thanks,
Ava Peterson
Procurement Manager | Cloudcap Inc.
ava.peterson@cloudcap.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Peterson <ava.peterson@cloudcap.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: who will send the invoice (email vs portal)?

Hi Ava — great to hear Cloudcap wants to move forward. Short answer: both are possible. Longer answer with options and recommended path: 

Option A — Portal push (recommended long-term)
- Redwood will publish invoices to your portal via API/webhook.
- Data: PDF + structured UBL payload (XML) for your AP system.
- Timeline: portal integration typically takes 1–2 weeks (we can accelerate with Connor).

Option B — Signed PDF by email (short-term fallback)
- We email a signed PDF to billing@cloudcap.com with VAT evidence attached.
- Works immediately; low lift for your AP team.

VAT / EU evidence
- We can attach a VAT certificate or invoice with VAT breakdown as PDF. If you require a certified EU VAT proof document, we can include a copy of our tax registration per entity (attach file on request).

Next steps I propose:
1) If you want portal only: share API endpoint + sample test creds and Connor will pick it up.
2) If you want email while portal onboarding completes: confirm billing@cloudcap.com and whether you need signed PDFs (we sign) and VAT certificate per invoice.

I attached an invoice sample template so you can confirm fields we populate.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(650) 555-0134

Attachment: invoice_sample_template.pdf

From: Ava Peterson <ava.peterson@cloudcap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloudcap Finance <billing@cloudcap.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: who will send the invoice (email vs portal)?

Thanks Marcus — that helps.

We'd like to do Option B for the first two invoices so our AP team can confirm mapping, then switch to Option A (portal push) as soon as Connor gives us a test endpoint.

For the PDFs: yes, please sign them and include VAT breakdown. For EU-registered entities we need the VAT registration attached as evidence; I attached our VAT process doc to this reply for reference.

Also: to avoid PO matching issues, can you include PO number and billing contact in the invoice header (PO-7732)?

If you can send an example signed PDF and the UBL/XML sample, we'll confirm with AP today. Our target is to accept the first PDF invoice by Nov 3.

Best,
Ava

Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: who will send the invoice (email vs portal)?

Hi Ava — picking up on VAT and signed PDF specifics.

A few items from legal/finance side: 
- For EU invoices we can attach the entity VAT registration (cloudcap_vat_certificate.pdf) or include the VAT ID field on the invoice itself. Which does your AP prefer?
- Our signed PDFs include signer name, date, and a simple certified stamp (not a 3rd-party e-signature). If you require DocuSign-level signatures, let us know — that will add steps.
- When we email PDFs we can also include a structured XML (UBL) as an attachment for your AP system to parse; see Connor's sample.

I'm attaching our VAT certificate for the entity that will invoice Cloudcap and a quick checklist for AP mapping (fields we populate).

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: cloudcap_vat_certificate.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ava Peterson <ava.peterson@cloudcap.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: who will send the invoice (email vs portal)?

Hi Ava — I set up a test payload and attached a UBL XML sample (e-invoice-UBL-sample.xml). Steps to move to portal push:

1) Send us a test endpoint and a set of API credentials (or temporary SFTP details).
2) We'll run an end-to-end push with a dummy invoice; you confirm field mapping.
3) Once mapping is confirmed we flip production over to portal push.

If you'd like to keep PDFs for the first two billing cycles we will:
- Email signed PDF to billing@cloudcap.com
- Attach e-invoice-UBL-sample.xml alongside the PDF so your AP can test import
- Include PO-7732 in the invoice header and a billing_contact field: "Cloudcap AP - invoicing@cloudcap.com"

Target timeline: dummy push by Nov 4; first live portal invoice the following week if all good. Please reply with the endpoint or confirm you want PDFs for Nov 3.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Attachments: e-invoice-UBL-sample.xml
